name: Amban phase-pulse blaster
description: The Amban phase-pulse blaster, also known as an Amban sniper rifle or Notimo-6 phase-pulse disruptor rifle, was a type of disruptor sniper rifle used by the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin. The weapon was capable of electrocuting opponents as well as completely disintegrating targets. It was also capable of listening to conversations at least a house away. Djarin used the deadly weapon to great effect during his bounty hunting career.
